description: Opening tokens (spec three-key model K3-4, K3-6, K3-6b; UNAUDITED): seed_leg = SHAKE256(SCAAS-PQZ-ENC-LEG-V1 || seed_enc || be4(0) || toUA || keccak256(pk_t))[0..32); the sender's own u_f, v_f = Enc([pk_f], [digits_f], seed_enc); the leg's u, v_t, v_a = Enc([pk_t, pk_a], [digits, digits], seed_leg) (keys: KeyGen seeds 0x46 / 0x54 / 0x41). Openings: coins = SHAKE256(SCAAS-PQZ-OPEN-COINS-V1 || seed_leg || u8(role) || keccak256(kemPk))[0..64), ML-KEM-1024 + X25519 of CTR-UA-32 with m = coins[0..32), e = coins[32..64), kek = HKDF-SHA256(ss, -, PQZ/opening/kek/v1), sealedSeed = AES-256-GCM(kek, 0^96, seed_leg, chainUid || token || ua || be8(keyVersion) || keccak256(P(u) || P(v))) = aad_t / aad_a, P the stored form of the op blob (PqzSet.PACK_BITS = ceil(log2 q) bits per coefficient, big-endian; CTR-PQZ-40); chainUid 0xC1.., token 0x70.., recipient 0x11.., auditor 0xA0.., key version 0, the readers' opening KEM keys from bip39 seed 0x4D.. (offchain-shared, version 0). openKemSeeds: HKDF-SHA256(bip39 seed, scaas.ua.kem.v1, scaas.kem.pqz-opening.1 || ua || chainUid || be64(v)) for an empty token (offchain-shared), scaas.kem.pqz-opening-token.1 || ua || chainUid || token || be64(v) otherwise, 96 B. rejects (review 3w-delta U2-2): one-change edits of the audited row's credit, field (to.opening, auditor.opening, to.kemPk) = value, with pqz-ffi's native outcomes of check_recipient (skip / accepted:<digits>) and check_auditor (read:<digits> / recipient-unreadable / unreadable); open: none = the edited opening opens to nothing for its reader (its openKemSeeds key, aad_t / aad_a, or the row's aad), else the seed_leg it opens to (then it is not K3-6's opening of its role: the auditor's Unreadable branch after the opening); seal: refused = seal to the edited kemPk refuses. Fields: to.opening, auditor.opening, to.kemPk, auditor.kemPk, chainUid and to.keyVersion (value be8; aad the edited credit's aad_t, under which the honest O_t opens to nothing).

rejects.case: O_t mlkemCt of another UA's key
